# Capability registry

<!-- Generated by scripts/dev/capability_tables.py; do not edit. -->

One table per method of `witwin/maxwell/capability/tables/`. `Simulation.<method>(scene, ...)` refuses every feature key whose row is not supported, and any key without a row, in one `UnsupportedFeatureError`. `mw.capabilities(method)` returns the same table.

| `symmetry.finite_plane_image_plane` | no | <owner> crosses the Scene.symmetry image plane on axis <axis> without being symmetric about it, so its flux in the mirrored domain is not a multiple of the folded-domain flux | center the rectangle on the image plane, keep it on the kept side, or simulate the full domain without Scene.symmetry | `tests/boundaries/symmetry/test_symmetry_generalization.py::test_finite_flux_plane_crossing_the_image_plane_asymmetrically_is_refused` |

## `fdfd`

| Feature key | Supported | Refusal | Alternative | Negative tests |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `background.homogeneous` | no | Homogeneous background declarations and physical Maxwell modes require the dedicated MoM dyadic runtime | use Simulation.mom(...) | `tests/api/public/test_capability_registry.py::test_refused_rows_are_reported` |
| `background.layer_stack` | no | A LayerStack background requires Simulation.mom(...) with MoMConfig.layered |  | `tests/mom/layered/test_layered_public.py::test_public_layered_guards`<br>`tests/api/public/test_capability_registry.py::test_refused_rows_are_reported` |
| `boundary.bloch` | no | FDFD supports per-face 'none', 'pml' and 'pec' boundaries only | use Simulation.fdtd(...), which supports it | `tests/fdfd/test_fdfd_silent_ignore_refusals.py::test_fdfd_refuses_scene_feature_at_construction` |
| `boundary.mode_abc` | no | FDFD supports per-face 'none', 'pml' and 'pec' boundaries only | use Simulation.fdtd(...), which supports it | `tests/fdfd/test_fdfd_silent_ignore_refusals.py::test_fdfd_refuses_scene_feature_at_construction` |
| `boundary.mur` | no | FDFD supports per-face 'none', 'pml' and 'pec' boundaries only | use Simulation.fdtd(...), which supports it | `tests/fdfd/test_fdfd_silent_ignore_refusals.py::test_fdfd_refuses_scene_feature_at_construction` |
| `boundary.none` | yes |  |  |  |
| `boundary.pec` | yes |  |  |  |
| `boundary.periodic` | no | FDFD supports per-face 'none', 'pml' and 'pec' boundaries only | use Simulation.fdtd(...), which supports it | `tests/fdfd/test_fdfd_silent_ignore_refusals.py::test_fdfd_refuses_scene_feature_at_construction` |
| `boundary.pmc` | no | FDFD supports per-face 'none', 'pml' and 'pec' boundaries only | use Simulation.fdtd(...), which supports it | `tests/fdfd/test_fdfd_silent_ignore_refusals.py::test_fdfd_refuses_scene_feature_at_construction` |
| `boundary.pml` | yes |  |  |  |
| `charge_density` | yes |  |  |  |
| `circuit` | yes |  |  |  |
| `coordinates` | no | BendCoordinates currently requires native FDTD | use Simulation.fdtd(...) | `tests/api/public/test_capability_registry.py::test_refused_rows_are_reported` |
| `electrostatic_terminal` | yes |  |  |  |
| `electrostatic_terminal.floating` | yes |  |  |  |
| `electrostatic_terminal.trainable_geometry` | yes |  |  |  |
| `geometry.planar_pec` | no | PlanarPEC requires the FDTD sheet runtime or MoM with a LayerStack background |  | `tests/mom/layered/test_layered_guards.py::test_planar_pec_requires_fdtd_or_layered_mom`<br>`tests/api/public/test_capability_registry.py::test_refused_rows_are_reported` |
| `geometry.surface_mesh` | no | FDFD has no zero-volume SurfaceMesh trace or thin-sheet operator and would drop the surface | use Simulation.fdtd(...), which supports it | `tests/fdfd/test_fdfd_silent_ignore_refusals.py::test_fdfd_refuses_scene_feature_at_construction` |
| `internal_absorber` | no | <count> InternalAbsorber(s) are not applied by FDFD | use Simulation.fdtd(...), which supports it | `tests/fdfd/test_fdfd_silent_ignore_refusals.py::test_fdfd_refuses_scene_feature_at_construction` |
| `lumped_element` | no | Lumped elements (<names>) are not stamped into the FDFD operator | use Simulation.fdtd(...), which supports it | `tests/fdfd/test_fdfd_silent_ignore_refusals.py::test_fdfd_refuses_scene_feature_at_construction` |
| `material.breakdown` | n/a | DielectricBreakdown is a time-domain feedback model (a latching conductivity update during time stepping) defined only for FDTD | set breakdown=None, or use Simulation.fdtd(...) | `tests/fdfd/test_fdfd_silent_ignore_refusals.py::test_fdfd_refuses_scene_feature_at_construction` |
| `material.copper_foil` | no | FDFD has no CopperFoil conductor model and would solve it as vacuum | use Simulation.fdtd(...), which supports it | `tests/fdfd/test_fdfd_silent_ignore_refusals.py::test_fdfd_refuses_scene_feature_at_construction` |
| `material.core_surface_fields` | no | core material field(s) <fields> are not modelled by FDFD | use a Maxwell material model (Material, LossyMetalMedium, CopperFoil, ...) | `tests/api/public/test_field_manifest.py::test_grid_solvers_refuse_core_surface_fields`<br>`tests/api/public/test_capability_registry.py::test_refused_rows_are_reported` |
| `material.full_tensor` | no | FDFD does not support full off-diagonal Tensor3x3 permittivity: the curl-curl assembly forms only per-axis diagonal material components | use Simulation.fdtd(...), which models the coupled tensor | `tests/fdfd/test_fdfd_silent_ignore_refusals.py::test_fdfd_refuses_scene_feature_at_construction` |
| `material.gyromagnetic` | no | FDFD does not support GyromagneticFerrite media: the frequency-domain solver would ingest only the diagonal background permeability and drop the non-reciprocal off-diagonal Polder gyrotropy | use Simulation.fdtd(...), whose magnetization-ADE runtime carries the gyromagnetic tensor | `tests/fdfd/test_fdfd_silent_ignore_refusals.py::test_fdfd_refuses_scene_feature_at_construction` |
| `material.lossy_metal` | no | FDFD has no LossyMetalMedium conductor model and would solve it as vacuum | use Simulation.fdtd(...), which supports it | `tests/fdfd/test_fdfd_silent_ignore_refusals.py::test_fdfd_refuses_scene_feature_at_construction` |
| `material.medium2d` | yes |  |  |  |
| `material.modulation` | n/a | FDFD would solve the time-modulated (ModulationSpec) material as its static permittivity | use Simulation.fdtd(...), which supports it | `tests/fdfd/test_fdfd_silent_ignore_refusals.py::test_fdfd_refuses_scene_feature_at_construction` |
| `material.nonlinear` | n/a | FDFD does not support Kerr nonlinear media (chi3, chi2, TPA): a frequency-domain solve has no single linear operator for a field-amplitude-dependent permittivity | use Simulation.fdtd(...), which models the nonlinearity directly | `tests/fdfd/test_fdfd_silent_ignore_refusals.py::test_fdfd_refuses_scene_feature_at_construction` |
| `material.perturbation` | yes |  |  |  |
| `material.pmc` | yes |  |  |  |
| `material.sigma_e` | yes |  |  |  |
| `material.surface_impedance` | no | FDFD has no SurfaceImpedanceMedium conductor model and would solve it as vacuum | use Simulation.fdtd(...), which supports it | `tests/fdfd/test_fdfd_silent_ignore_refusals.py::test_fdfd_refuses_scene_feature_at_construction` |
| `material.trainable_mu_r` | yes |  |  |  |
